note: The worked fixture for the extraction schema. Eight claims, chosen because between them they exercise every field: an interleaved advertisement, an ad dateline older than the issue, a relative placement whose offset words the primary witness lost to column segmentation and the alternate witness supplies, a business with no legible street, a post-office letter list, and two listed persons who share a surname and must never merge.

alt_transcription_2.note: The single-pass `-2` rebuild. Worse everywhere, and it carries no page/column markers, so nothing may be CITED from it — it appears here only to corroborate a claim already located in the primary. Twice in this fixture it holds words the primary's column segmentation cut off.
